items.title: Exploited SonicWall SSL-VPN flaw lets attackers bypass SAML-enforced MFA (CVE-2026-19868)

items.title: DHS Has Used This Controversial Investigative Tool 185,000 Times Since Trump Took Office
items.summary: Homeland Security Investigations estimates that it has sent out more administrative subpoenas since January 2025 than it did in more than six and a half years between 2016 and mid-August 2022.
